execution_contract.filesystem_policy: Preserve all pre-existing user-owned changes and unrelated hunks. Use apply_patch for manual edits. No destructive reset, checkout, broad delete, or overwrite.
execution_contract.git_policy: No commits, pushes, branches, rebases, resets, checkouts, staging, or cleanup of user changes.
execution_contract.evidence_policy: Claims may use only frozen sources, the baseline ledger, explicit delegated decisions, and artifacts produced and reviewed in this dispatch. Uncertainty remains visible.
execution_contract.component_policy: No essay, interviewer, profile, schema, skill edit, research program, automation, code, test harness, or new specialization is presumed necessary. The architecture plan must disposition every candidate as build-now, retain-existing, defer, or reject, with evidence and owner.
execution_contract.worktree_policy: s00 records the complete initial git status and hashes of every in-scope existing file. Later validators compare changes against that ledger and block unrelated mutation.
execution_contract.seat_receipt_contract: Every attempted seat and every iteration owns one immutable receipt at .arcanum/observability/runs/need-driven-system-writing-implementation-v1/{step_id}/{iteration_id}/{role_id}.json. No two role_id/iteration_id pairs share a receipt. A not-needed role gets a non-spawn lifecycle entry only, not a fabricated completed receipt.
execution_contract.receipt_index_policy: Step-level indexes, when useful, are mechanical lists of seat receipt path/hash/status tuples owned by baseline_steward for s00 and terminal_reconciler for pre-terminal inspection; they never replace seat receipts or synthesize model judgment.

convergence_criteria: Four attackers fan out together, each independently reads the whole frozen target corpus, and each takes exactly one lens: fidelity/governance, mechanics/correctness, operability, or abuse/gaming. Writer, verifier, coverage auditor, and dedicated approver remain downstream in that order.
Review writer and stable verifier zig-zag until the verifier raises no objection or three exchanges are exhausted.
Refuted findings are dropped; every survivor quotes the target artifact, states CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR, and gives one-line fix.
Coverage auditor checks target-by-lens coverage and fires the all-zero-findings red flag; dedicated approver only approves or blocks the frozen list.

Persist exactly one review artifact, review.md; never persist attacker/verifier transcripts, rejected or refuted finding content, attacks.md, or findings.md. Unique receipts may contain lifecycle, lens/target coverage, counts, hashes, convergence state, and final approval only.

review_contract.per_artifact_verdict: KEEP iff no verified CRITICAL or MAJOR; otherwise FIX

stop_conditions: BLOCK if target corpus is not exact/frozen, any target lacks lens coverage, approver has another role, or review topology identities overlap.

evidence_expectations: If review verdict is KEEP, emit a no-op pass receipt and preserve frozen targets.

MINOR findings may remain as explicit residue and do not force repair unless they obstruct correctness.

Dropped/refuted finding content and all attacker/verifier working returns remain ephemeral and are never persisted. The current review.md contains only Coverage, verified surviving change requests with quoted target evidence, per-artifact verdicts, and required report fields.

Receipt resolves the exact runtime path, timestamp, hash, line count, and frontmatter parse result.

host runtime or ACI journal evidence that x01 was joined/closed and no dispatch seat remains live (not persisted bridge stdout)
